ZAF.note: Only a call for a critical-infrastructure directive; no body, strategy, designation or figures stated.

facts.fact: ITWeb says the Cyber Crimes Act, signed into law in May 2021, came into partial operation on 1 December 2021.
ITWeb says the Cyber Security Bill is still in development, with experts including Jacqueline Fick drafting it.

ZAF.note: Consultation mentioned is not stated to be online.

facts.fact: ITWeb says that after public consultation on the Cyber Crimes and Cyber Security Bill, the cyber security aspects were removed to make a standalone Cyber Crimes Act.
facts.system: Cyber Crimes and Cyber Security Bill

ZAF.note: Consultation date not given; publication date used.
